verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 is a data-center GPU, and a sandbox environment separate from production data is a property of software or services, not accelerator hardware. The evidence shows no H200 sandbox or test-environment capability. MIG partitioning, Confidential Computing, and the separate Brev Launchables product are adjacent features and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
